title: 第3章 庶妹提前动手了
lines: 相府的“恐惧”，并没有让局停下来。
苏柔已经三天没有出院。
相反，这三天，她几乎没睡。
一个能把苏晚彻底按死的机会。
她坐在烛火前，手指慢慢划过一只小瓷瓶。
普通到像药房里随手可拿的清热散。
但里面的东西，却不是药。
这是她从外面高价买来的。
卖药的人只说了一句话：
“只让人，在最重要的场合，失去呼吸。”
她抬手，将瓷瓶递给丫鬟。
content_zh:
相府的风，开始变了。

    不是天气的变。

    是人心的变。

    老太君醒来之后，整个府里表面安静，暗地里却像一根被拉到极限的弦。

    谁都在等。

    等苏晚下一步出错。

    尤其是苏柔。

    她等得最急。

    清晨，苏晚刚踏出西偏院。

    门外就站着一群人。

    苏柔。

    还有她身后的两个嬷嬷。

    以及——一群“看热闹”的下人。

    苏柔今日换了一身素白衣裙，脸上甚至还刻意带了点憔悴。

    看起来像受了天大委屈。

    她一见苏晚，就红了眼眶。

    “姐姐。”

    声音柔得发颤。

    “你为什么要这样对我？”

    苏晚停住脚步。

    没说话。

    只是看着她。

    苏柔被她这一眼看得心里莫名一紧，但很快又压下去。

    她今天是来“收局”的。

    不是来怕的。

    苏柔抬起手，轻轻擦了擦眼角。

    “昨夜，你房中丢失的那包药粉，是我帮你收着的。”

    一句话落下。

    周围人立刻哗然。

    “药粉？”

    “什么药粉？”

    苏柔继续，声音更低更委屈。

    “姐姐你说你要研究医理，我怕你被人发现，就替你收了。”

    “可今日……居然在老太君的药里查出来了。”

    她抬头，看向苏晚。

    眼泪刚好落下。

    “姐姐，你为什么要害老太君？”

    这一句，像刀子一样落下。

    人群瞬间炸开。

    “天啊……竟然是她？”

    “老太君中毒是她做的？”

    “她昨天还救人，今天就下毒？！”

    相府下人脸色大变。

    连嬷嬷都下意识后退了一步。

    苏柔心里一松。

    成了。

    这局很简单。

    ——嫁祸。

    药粉是她提前准备好的。

    只要在老太君药里“发现”，再加上她的“人证”，苏晚百口莫辩。

    一个“救人”，一个“下毒”。

    足够把她彻底钉死。

    苏柔看着苏晚，眼底闪过一丝狠意。

    “姐姐，你还要狡辩吗？”

    苏晚终于开口。

    声音很轻。

    “说完了？”

    苏柔一愣。

    “什么？”

    苏晚看着她。

    眼神很平。

    平得像在看一场早就知道结局的戏。

    “你说我下毒。”

    “证据呢？”

    苏柔立刻抬手。

    “药粉就在这里！”

    她身后的嬷嬷立刻端上一个小布包。

    打开。

    里面是暗褐色粉末。

    “这是从你房里搜出来的！”

    “还有昨夜你院里的丫鬟可以作证！”

    人群再次哗然。

    苏柔心里稳了。

    她甚至开始期待苏晚崩溃的样子。

    可苏晚没有崩。
content_en:
The atmosphere in the Prime Minister's Mansion began to change.

    It's not a change in weather.

    It's a change in people's hearts.

    After the old lady woke up, the whole house was quiet on the surface, but secretly it was like a string being stretched to its limit.

    Everyone is waiting.

    Wait for Su Wan to make the next mistake.

    Especially Su Rou.

    She waited most impatiently.

    In the early morning, Su Wan had just stepped out of the west courtyard.

    There was a group of people standing outside the door.

    Su Rou.

    And the two nuns behind her.

    And - a group of servants "watching the fun".

    Su Rou changed into a plain white dress today, and even looked a little haggard on her face.

    It looked like he had been greatly wronged.

    When she saw Su Wan, her eyes turned red.

    "Sister."

    The voice was so soft that it trembled.

    "Why are you doing this to me?"

    Su Wan stopped.

    No words were spoken.

    Just look at her.

    Su Rou felt inexplicably nervous at her sight, but she quickly suppressed it.

    She is here to "finish the game" today.

    Not here to be afraid.

    Su Rou raised her hand and gently wiped the corners of her eyes.

    "I helped you collect the packet of medicinal powder that was lost in your room last night."

    One sentence fell.

    The people around were immediately in an uproar.

    "Powder?"

    "What powder?"

    Su Rou continued, her voice lower and more aggrieved.

    "Sister, you said you wanted to study medicine. I was afraid that you would be discovered, so I took it away for you."

    "But today...it was actually found in the old lady's medicine."

    She raised her head and looked at Su Wan.

    The tears just fell.

    "Sister, why did you want to harm the old lady?"

    This sentence fell like a knife.

    The crowd exploded instantly.

    "Oh my god...it's actually her?"

    "Is it her fault that the old lady was poisoned?"

    "She saved people yesterday, but she poisoned them today?!"

    The expressions of the servants in the Prime Minister's Mansion changed greatly.

    Even grandma subconsciously took a step back.

    Su Rou felt relieved.

    It’s done.

    This game is very simple.

    ——Place the blame.

    The medicinal powder was prepared by her in advance.

    As long as it was "discovered" in the old lady's medicine and her "witness" was provided, Su Wan could not argue.

    One "rescues" and the other "poisons".

    Enough to crucify her completely.

    Su Rou looked at Su Wan, with a trace of cruelty flashing in her eyes.

    "Sister, do you still want to quibble?"

    Su Wan finally spoke.

    The voice is very soft.

    "Finished?"

    Su Rou was stunned.

    "What?"

    Su Wan looked at her.

    The eyes are very flat.

    It was as flat as watching a play whose ending was already known.

    "You said I poisoned you."

    "Where's the evidence?"

    Su Rou immediately raised her hand.

    "The powder is right here!"

    The nun behind her immediately brought a small cloth bag.

    Open.

    Inside is dark brown powder.

    "This was found from your room!"

    "And the maid in your courtyard last night can testify!"

    The crowd was in uproar again.

    Su Rou felt calm.

    She even began to look forward to Su Wan's collapse.

    But Su Wan didn't collapse.
title_en: Chapter 3 The concubine takes action in advance
